aha: Stepping out of a sand notch lets the pearl/stone beside it roll into the hole below: release the pearl onto the crab, a stone onto the piranha (it also plugs the pit), a stone into the middle pit, then pull the pinned pearl down from below last so its stone falls in behind it.
deadlocks: Releasing the pearl when the crab is not underneath: the crab survives and walls off the pearl lane (or kills you at the entry), so you have to undo.
Releasing the stone when the piranha is not under it: the stone still plugs the pit, but the piranha lives and charges you as soon as you dig into its room.
Pushing the left pearl along the trench before the middle pit is plugged: it drops into the pit and is lost.
Pulling the pinned right-hand pearl down before the left pearl has passed: its stone drops into the lane behind it and walls off the left pearl.
Stepping right instead of left after pulling the pinned pearl down: the diver ends up on the gate side and can only push it away from the gate.
